item.title: Congressional Hearing on Roblox Safety and Arbitration
item.description: Survivors testified before a Senate subcommittee on Roblox grooming, spurring legislation to end forced arbitration and let families sue Roblox.

item.title: Senate Pushes New Online Harm Laws Targeting Roblox
item.description: Lawmakers demand ending forced arbitration for online harms, spotlighting Roblox’s clause that shields the platform from child‑grooming lawsuits.
